operations.body: Complementary audit complete, without launching the next target reduction. Over F_32003 the strict ambient-13 remainder spaces have rank 13 for T1, rank 13 for T2, and combined rank 26, hence intersection zero. No paired source direction is equal or proportional across tangents; paired differences have rank 13. Yet support overlap is 79/81 columns (one T1-only and one T2-only column). Quadratic coordinate images each have rank 13, combined rank 18, hence intersect in dimension 8. Thus shared column support does not identify tangent residual classes; the next strict map must retain tangent provenance. Artifact: research/benincasa/triangle-wall-strict-residual-module.json; checker: analyze_triangle_wall_strict_residual_module.py. This classifies the finite residual module only and does not preempt your next-target derivation.
